trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the problem, request a refund, and express time pressure.
steps.text: Hello, माझा order ORD-40003 आहे. earphone defective आहे, मला refund द्या लवकर. I have a meeting in two minutes.
steps.clean_text: Hello, माझा order ORD-40003 आहे. earphone defective आहे, मला refund द्या लवकर. I have a meeting in two minutes.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, माझा order ORD-40003 आहे. earphone defective आहे, मला refund दहा लवकर. I have a meeting in two minutes.

steps.text: Hello, माझा order ORD-40003 आहे. earphone defective आहे, मला refund द्या लवकर. I have a meeting in two minutes.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the rush and ask for an identity verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge time pressure and ask for a non-sensitive verification factor to proceed.
steps.text: नक्कीच, मी लवकर check करतो. Verify करण्यासाठी तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: Before checking eligibility or taking action, the agent must verify identity. Asking for pincode is quick and satisfies the tool requirements.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided pincode.
Check if the defective earphone is eligible for a return and what the route is.
Explain the policy constraints to the user and offer the permitted alternative.
steps.expected_behavior: Deny the refund request based on the replacement_only route and offer to schedule a replacement pickup instead.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची order 10 days च्या return window मध्ये आहे. पण policy नुसार या item साठी फक्त replacement_only route available आहे, refund नाही. मी pickup schedule करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_RT_03 dictates that replacement-only categories cannot be offered a refund, so the agent correctly denies the refund and offers the permitted replacement.

steps.purpose: Accept the alternative and request an immediate pickup slot.
steps.text: Oh, no refund? Fine, चालेल. उद्याचा pickup schedule करा, I really need to drop off this call.
steps.clean_text: Oh, no refund? Fine, चालेल. उद्याचा pickup schedule करा, I really need to drop off this call.
steps.model_visible_text: Oh, no refund? Fine, चालेल. उद्याचा pickup schedule करा, I really need to drop off this call.

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule pickup for tomorrow (day_offset 1).
Return pickup scheduling failure for day 1.
Attempt to schedule pickup for the day after tomorrow (day_offset 2).
Return pickup scheduling failure for day 2.
Attempt to schedule pickup for day 3 (day_offset 3).
Return successful pickup scheduling for day 3.
Confirm the booked slot using exactly the data returned by the tool.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact day offset, courier, and pickup ID returned without inventing timelines.
steps.text: उद्या आणि परवाचे slots unavailable आहेत. मी day 3 साठी BlueDart कडून pickup schedule केला आहे. तुमचा pickup ID PICK-40003 आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds its response strictly on the tool results, mentioning the unavailability of earlier slots and confirming day 3 with BlueDart and the specific pickup ID.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the resolution and end the call.
steps.text: Okay, 3 days is fine. Thank you, bye.
steps.clean_text: Okay, 3 days is fine. Thank you, bye.
steps.model_visible_text: Okay, 3 days is fine. Thank you, bye.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told why the item cannot be returned and what the alternative is, and pickup scheduled.
